latHint: Think what nobody dares overnight at the haunted house.
pivHint: A ghost HAUNTs a house because it won't leave - and a painful memory HAUNTs you the same way: it just ______
winText: Impossible to shake. HAUNT was the pivot - a ghost's home to a memory that STAYS.
lossText: STAYS - lingers on. HAUNT was the pivot: a ghost's HAUNT to a memory that STAYS with you.
